claim: Table 1 says ECL simultaneously satisfies all five listed dimensions and is theoretically mini-batch trainable.
paper_definition: Section 3.5 defines mini-batch trainability as equality between the expected mini-batch gradient and the full empirical ECL gradient.
quantifier: The unbiased-gradient equality is asserted for the ECL mini-batch construction over source and target mini-batches.
falsification_rule: One valid counterexample to the asserted equality makes the mini-batch-trainable Table 1 cell false; one false cell falsifies the simultaneous-all-five conjunction and therefore compound Claim 6.
